title: Blocking mu-opioid receptor by naltrexone exaggerates oxidative stress and airway inflammation via the MAPkinase pathway in a murine model of asthma.
authors: Pandey, Vinita; Yadav, Vandana; Srivastava, Atul; Gaglani, Pratikkumar; Singh, Rashmi; Subhashini
one_liner_zh: 该文研究纳曲酮阻断μ阿片受体对哮喘气道炎症的影响，仅涉及小分子-受体对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Opioids regulate various physiological and pathophysiological functions, including cell proliferation, immune function, obesity, and neurodegenerative disorders. They have been used for centuries as a treatment for severe pain, binding to opioid receptors a specific G protein-coupled receptor. Common opioids, like beta-endorphin, [D-Ala2, N-MePhe4, Gly-ol]-enkephalin (DAMGO), and dynorphins, have analgesic effects. The use of a potent antagonist, like naltrexone hydrochloride, to block the effects of mu Opioid Receptor (muOR) may result in the withdrawal of physiological effects and could potentially impact immune responses in many diseases including respiratory disease. Asthma is a respiratory disease characterized by airway hyperresponsiveness, inflammation, bronchoconstriction, chest tightness, stress generation and release of various cytokines. Airway inflammation leads recruitment and activation of immune cells releasing mediators, including opioids, which may modulate inflammatory response by binding to their respective receptors. The study aims to explore the role of muOR antagonist (naltrexone) in regulating asthma pathophysiology, as the regulation of immune and inflammatory responses in asthma remains unclear. Balb/c mice were sensitized intranasally by 1% TDI and challenged with 2.5% TDI. Naltrexone hydrochloride (1 mg/kg body weight) was administered through intraperitoneal route 1 h before TDI induction. Blocking muOR by naltrexone exacerbates airway inflammation by recruiting inflammatory cells (lymphocytes and neutrophils), enhancing intracellular Reactive oxygen species in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF), and inflammatory mediator (histamine, Eosinophil peroxidase and neutrophil elastase) in lungs. Naltrexone administration modulated inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-4, IL-5, IL-6, IL-10, and IL-17A), and enhanced IgE and CRP levels. Naltrexone administration also increased the expression of NF-kappaB, and phosphorylated p-P38, p-Erk, p-JNK and NF-kappaB by inhibiting the muOR. Docking study revealed good binding affinity of naltrexone with muOR compared to delta and kappa receptors. In future it might elucidate potential therapeutic against many respiratory pathological disorders. In conclusion, muOR blocking by naltrexone regulates and implicates inflammation, bronchoconstriction, and lung physiology.
abstract_zh: 阿片类药物调节多种生理和病理生理功能，包括细胞增殖、免疫功能、肥胖和神经退行性疾病。它们几个世纪以来一直被用于治疗严重疼痛，通过与阿片受体（一种特定的G蛋白偶联受体）结合发挥作用。常见的阿片类药物，如β-内啡肽、[D-Ala2, N-MePhe4, Gly-ol]-脑啡肽（DAMGO）和强啡肽，具有镇痛效果。使用强效拮抗剂，如盐酸纳曲酮，阻断μ阿片受体（muOR）的作用可能导致生理效应的撤除，并可能影响包括呼吸系统疾病在内的许多疾病中的免疫反应。哮喘是一种呼吸系统疾病，其特征为气道高反应性、炎症、支气管收缩、胸闷、应激产生及多种细胞因子的释放。气道炎症导致免疫细胞募集和激活，释放包括阿片类药物在内的介质，这些介质可能通过结合其相应受体来调节炎症反应。本研究旨在探讨muOR拮抗剂（纳曲酮）在调节哮喘病理生理中的作用，因为哮喘中免疫和炎症反应的调节仍不清楚。Balb/c小鼠通过鼻内致敏1% TDI，并用2.5% TDI激发。在TDI诱导前1小时，通过腹腔注射给予盐酸纳曲酮（1 mg/kg体重）。通过纳曲酮阻断muOR加剧了气道炎症，表现为募集炎症细胞（淋巴细胞和中性粒细胞）、增强支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）中的细胞内活性氧，以及肺中炎症介质（组胺、嗜酸性粒细胞过氧化物酶和中性粒细胞弹性蛋白酶）的增加。纳曲酮给药调节了炎症细胞因子（TNF-α、IL-4、IL-5、IL-6、IL-10和IL-17A），并增强了IgE和CRP水平。纳曲酮给药还通过抑制muOR增加了NF-κB、磷酸化p-P38、p-Erk、p-JNK和NF-κB的表达。对接研究显示，与δ和κ受体相比，纳曲酮与muOR具有良好的结合亲和力。未来，这可能阐明针对多种呼吸系统病理紊乱的潜在治疗策略。总之，通过纳曲酮阻断muOR调节并影响炎症、支气管收缩和肺生理。
